Date: 2028-07-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Onsite demo — scheduling and NDA

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the product overview last week. We're ready to plan an in-person HQ demo so our engineering and clinical informatics teams can see Redwood running on real workloads. We're targeting a visit for ~12 people (mix of engineers and a couple of execs). Preferred windows: Aug 2–3 or the week of Aug 7.

Two quick asks up front: can you confirm (1) whether you require a signed NDA before the visit, and (2) whether you can reserve a conference room with full AV and a small adjacent staging space for laptops and test devices?

If you prefer, send over a few times and we'll lock one. We'll also coordinate travel once the date is set.

Olivia
Olivia Hart
Head of Platform Integrations
Aurora Medical
olivia.hart@auroramed.com

Subject: Re: Onsite demo — scheduling and NDA

Hi Olivia — great to hear, and happy to host. Short answers: yes, we do prefer an NDA on file for any customer demos that include product internals; and yes, we can reserve a conference suite with dedicated staging and AV.

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Fri Aug 2, 10:00–13:00 (room + staging)
- Tue Aug 8, 14:00–17:00 (room + staging)

Can you confirm: final attendee headcount, which exec needs a remote seat (we'll set up a quiet room + dedicated feed), and any dietary restrictions for lunch? Also let us know if you'll need pre-badging (we can pre-clear badges if we have the attendee list and one ID per external visitor).

I've looped in Marissa (ops) to hold the rooms tentatively and Connor (security) for badging and NDA guidance. If Aug 8 works, we'll mark it tentative until we get the signed NDA and attendee list.

Thanks — Soojin
Soojin Lee

Subject: Re: Onsite demo — pre-badge and security checklist

Hi Olivia — thanks for the NDA and attendee list. We can pre-badge all external visitors if we receive the following minimal information for each external attendee: full name, company, email, and the last 4 of a government ID (passport or driver's license). If you prefer not to share ID fragments, we can still expedite on arrival but will require an extra 10–15 minutes per guest for manual verification.

For the contractor (Tom Fields), please confirm whether he will be presenting or only observing — contractors that access internal test systems require a one-page sponsored access form (I'll send a DocuSign link).

Pre-badge DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/aurora-prebadge
Redwood pre-clear window: we need the list + ID fragments by EOD July 25 to pre-clear for Aug 8.

We'll also attach temporary guest badges on arrival and provide an escort. Vehicle plate numbers for the two passes will be fine; we can also add shuttle info if needed.

Connor O'Brien
Security Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
